description: This file defines the TabGroupHelper class, which provides methods to retrieve available modules and save tab group configurations within the SuiteCRM project. It handles localization, configuration persistence, and manipulation of module and tab group data.

classes.name: TabGroupHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing tab groups and module availability, including localization support and saving configurations.

methods.name: getAvailableModules
methods.description: Returns a list of available modules, optionally localized to a specified language. Caches results for efficiency.

methods.name: saveTabGroups
methods.description: Processes input parameters to save and update tab group configurations, including localization strings and cache clearing.
